headline: BSP raises rates, signals more hikes
summary: The Philippine central bank increased its benchmark interest rate for the first time in the current cycle and signaled further hikes. The report does not give the size of the increase.
why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas sets the policy rate that anchors Philippine borrowing costs, bond yields and the peso. Its decisions shape lending conditions and inflation expectations across the economy.
why_moved: The central bank raised its benchmark rate and signaled more hikes, which directly changes the policy rate path that investors price into local bonds and the currency.
